confidence: Low. A death and opened cyanide bottle now support a poisoning hypothesis, but no toxicology or named handler connects them.
plausibility_notes: Split custody band and earlier intact photographs provide a tangible before-and-after clue.
Death after toast makes the private glass a reasonable route, but timing alone does not prove poisoning through it.
Poison retained for a murder exhibition is conspicuous genre machinery; custody photos help ground the chain of evidence.
Artie has the clearest established personal motive; Chip and Brie have plausible access routes rather than proven culpability.
